roadmap.title: Columbia: 1999 Mode and collection
roadmap.description: Unlock 1999 Mode from the main menu and start the campaign on that difficulty. Keep the Infusion, viewing-device, and Voxophone checklists open from the beginning. Avoid all Dollar Bill purchases for Scavenger Hunt; weapon and Vigor upgrade machines are allowed. A lower-difficulty first run followed by a focused 1999 run is an optional easier route.

roadmap.title: Burial at Sea – Episode 1
roadmap.description: Play on any difficulty. Collect the Market Street diaries before Cohen and the Pavilion diaries before the tram. Save 350 dollars for a pair of upgrades, then finish Radar Range and Old Man Winter tasks in Housewares before raising the thermostat. Recover missed diaries and turret kills by replaying the relevant chapter.

roadmap.title: Burial at Sea – Episode 2
roadmap.description: Start in 1998 Mode for Taffer’s Delight. Work on stealth knockouts and lockpicking while collecting the recordings. Take the Columbia airship recording before the ship leaves. Chapter select can recover missing recordings.

roadmap.title: Clash in the Clouds
roadmap.description: Clear each arena and purchase useful upgrades before focusing on its Blue Ribbons. Work through the weapon and Vigor kill roster, buy every Gallery exhibit, and retry the 60 wave objectives. After a failed ribbon, continue to preserve earlier progress rather than restarting the checkpoint.

Take the bank bottle before defeating Lady Comstock there; if you miss a bottle, replay from a chapter before that bottle and continue the campaign through every later Infusion.

achievements.description: In CitC, knocked an enemy off the city with Undertow, then rescued him, then knocked him off again.
achievements.summary: In Clash in the Clouds, use Undertow to push an enemy downward, pull that enemy back, then push the same enemy downward to a fatal fall.

steps.text: Stand near a ledge with a living soldier nearby. Tap Undertow to push the soldier into open air.
Immediately hold Undertow to pull the same soldier back, then tap it again to send the soldier over the edge to die.

achievements.description: In CitC, used all eight different vigor combos to deliver the killing blow on an enemy.
achievements.summary: In Clash in the Clouds, kill an enemy using each of the eight Vigor combinations.

guide.context: For Charge and Undertow combinations, falling to death does not count as the required Vigor kill.

steps.text: Use the eight combinations listed below, weakening enemies first so the Vigor effect delivers the finishing damage.
Affect an enemy with Possession, then use Devil’s Kiss on that same enemy.
Affect an enemy with Possession, then use Shock Jockey on that same enemy.
Cast Murder of Crows at a target, then strike that target with Devil’s Kiss.
Cast Murder of Crows at a target, then strike that target with Shock Jockey.
Affect an enemy with Bucking Bronco, then use Devil’s Kiss on that same enemy.
Affect an enemy with Bucking Bronco, then use Charge on that same enemy.
Affect an enemy with Devil’s Kiss, then use Charge on that same enemy.
Affect an enemy with Shock Jockey, then use Undertow on that same enemy.
For each Possession combination, ignite or electrify the controlled enemy and let that enemy kill another opponent.

achievements.description: In CitC, killed an enemy with splash damage by shooting a rocket out of the air.
achievements.summary: In Clash in the Clouds, kill an enemy with the blast from a rocket you shoot in midair.

steps.text: Leave an RPG soldier alive and weaken the soldier or a nearby enemy.
Aim near the RPG muzzle with a rapid-firing gun. Shoot the rocket just after launch so its explosion kills an enemy.

achievements.description: In CitC, completed all Blue Ribbon Challenges.
achievements.summary: Earn all 60 Blue Ribbons in Clash in the Clouds.

guide.context: Each arena has 15 ribbons. Retry a failed challenge on a later arena run. Restart Checkpoint returns to the lobby and can erase ribbons earned during the current attempt. If you die without a revive, select @mechanic{Forfeit Ranking & Continue} to retain earlier ribbons. Remove Gear that adds damage before weapon-only challenges. You can buy up to four revives per arena run. In Raven’s Dome, enemies can fall from arriving airships and invalidate restricted challenges.

collectibles.name: Wave 1
collectibles.location: Finish enemies exclusively through Sky-Line Strikes.
collectibles.method: Ride the rails and leap onto each soldier with a strike.

collectibles.name: Wave 2
collectibles.location: Keep all damage confined to the Shield.
collectibles.method: Fight from cover near the starting area. Retreat before the Shield breaks.

collectibles.name: Wave 3
collectibles.location: Deal damage only with the Shotgun and Sky-Hook.
collectibles.method: Bring an upgraded Shotgun and use melee or Sky-Line Strikes when close.

collectibles.name: Wave 4
collectibles.location: Use the Crank Gun, Machine Gun, or Repeater exclusively.
collectibles.method: Use the Machine Gun or Repeater; obtain a Crank Gun from its Tear if desired. Prioritize Volley Gunners with headshots.

collectibles.name: Wave 5
collectibles.location: Use only the Pistol and Hand Cannon.
collectibles.method: Bait the Handyman into grabbing the Sky-Line, then shoot the heart with these weapons.

collectibles.name: Wave 6
collectibles.location: Pick up no weapons and loot no bodies.
collectibles.method: Bring well-stocked weapons and use Vigors as needed. Leave all dropped weapons and corpses alone.

collectibles.name: Wave 7
collectibles.location: Fire only zoomable weapons, always while aiming down sights.
collectibles.method: Equip a Carbine, Hand Cannon, or Sniper Rifle. Stay zoomed for every shot.

collectibles.name: Wave 8
collectibles.location: Win using Tears, Possession traps, or Return to Sender traps.
collectibles.method: Cycle the Tesla Coil and turret Tears to secure every kill; this avoids the unreliable Return to Sender trap credit.

collectibles.name: Wave 9
collectibles.location: Hit neither heads nor hearts.
collectibles.method: Use body shots and Vigors on soldiers. Aim explosive shots behind the Handyman rather than at its chest.

collectibles.name: Wave 10
collectibles.location: Kill the Siren before any resurrection.
collectibles.method: Drop to the corpses below the starting point immediately and focus upgraded Devil’s Kiss and high-damage gunfire on the Siren.

collectibles.name: Wave 11
collectibles.location: Use neither Sky-Lines nor Freight Hooks.
collectibles.method: Move between cover on foot. Stun the Patriot and Fireman with Shock Jockey and defeat them quickly.

collectibles.name: Wave 12
collectibles.location: Finish within 75 seconds.
collectibles.method: Use Undertow to throw the four enemies over ledges, or quickly finish them with upgraded weapons.

collectibles.name: Wave 13
collectibles.location: Attack only by Sky-Line gunfire or Sky-Line Strikes.
collectibles.method: Shoot the Firemen from the rails. Dismount when the Handyman electrifies the line, then reattach before attacking again.

collectibles.name: Wave 14
collectibles.location: Use only Shock Jockey and headshots.
collectibles.method: Stun approaching enemies and aim carefully at heads. A body hit fails the objective.

collectibles.name: Wave 15
collectibles.location: Give every enemy a different Vigor finishing blow.
collectibles.method: Weaken targets with gunfire, then use a different damaging Vigor to finish each one. Reserve a separate Vigor for each remaining target.

collectibles.name: Wave 1
collectibles.location: Defeat every enemy with the Shotgun.
collectibles.method: Use the Shotgun Tear immediately right of the spawn to refill ammunition.

collectibles.name: Wave 2
collectibles.location: Have a Possessed Patriot kill two enemies.
collectibles.method: Weaken soldiers, then possess the Patriot and draw those soldiers into its reach.

collectibles.name: Wave 3
collectibles.location: Trigger three Fireman self-destructs while Bucking Bronco or Undertow holds them airborne.
collectibles.method: Weaken Firemen, lift them with Bucking Bronco, and shoot them until their self-destruct begins while still airborne.

collectibles.name: Wave 4
collectibles.location: Damage five enemies with Vigor traps.
collectibles.method: Place Shock Jockey traps where soldiers approach; kills are unnecessary.

collectibles.name: Wave 5
collectibles.location: Finish within 45 seconds.
collectibles.method: Shoot the distant snipers first, then defeat the soldiers moving toward the spawn.

collectibles.name: Wave 6
collectibles.location: Kill the Handyman while it electrifies a Sky-Line.
collectibles.method: Reduce its health first. Mount and dismount to bait the grab, then shoot the heart while its hands remain on the line.

collectibles.name: Wave 7
collectibles.location: Kill five enemies with Undertow.
collectibles.method: Pull enemies from their airships and throw them over the edge. Refill using the Salts Tear.

collectibles.name: Wave 8
collectibles.location: Get two kills from a Possessed rocket turret.
collectibles.method: Possess the arriving airship’s rocket turret while soldiers are in its firing path. Refresh Possession before it expires.

collectibles.name: Wave 9
collectibles.location: Use a different weapon or Vigor for each killing blow.
collectibles.method: Track each finishing attack and switch to an unused weapon or Vigor after every kill. Pick up enemy weapons for more choices.

collectibles.name: Wave 10
collectibles.location: Use only Charge, Return to Sender, and Shotguns.
collectibles.method: Bring the Shotgun and Heater. Remove Volley Gunners first so their stray blasts do not kill other enemies.

collectibles.name: Wave 11
collectibles.location: Have a Possessed enemy kill the Patriot.
collectibles.method: Weaken and stun the Patriot, then possess nearby soldiers and let them finish it.

collectibles.name: Wave 12
collectibles.location: Kill every enemy through Vigor traps.
collectibles.method: Place upgraded Murder of Crows traps on the first airship and lure enemies through them. Use Devil’s Kiss traps for close threats.

collectibles.name: Wave 13
collectibles.location: Kill five enemies with one Devil’s Kiss blast.
collectibles.method: Create the Oil Puddle Tear. Pull at least five soldiers into it with Undertow, hold them with Bucking Bronco, and ignite the group with a Devil’s Kiss trap.

collectibles.name: Wave 14

collectibles.method: Remove the soldiers, weaken the Handyman, and circle the exposed Tesla Coil while it finishes the target.

collectibles.name: Wave 15
collectibles.location: Finish within 90 seconds.
collectibles.method: Reach the far Zeppelin and destroy its engines, then jump back out before the 90-second limit expires. You can bypass soldiers if you can reach the engines safely.

collectibles.location: Use only Sky-Hook damage.
collectibles.method: Finish enemies with melee, executions, or Sky-Line Strikes. Avoid damaging Vigor effects.

collectibles.method: Possess soldiers so opponents attack them. Possession-ending suicides also contribute; leave the Patriot hostile to help kill controlled soldiers.

collectibles.location: Kill the Volley Gunners and Zealot before hurting any sniper.
collectibles.method: Remove the Zealot and both Volley Gunners first. The ordinary soldier may be killed whenever convenient.

collectibles.name: Wave 8
collectibles.location: Get every kill through turrets or environmental hazards.
collectibles.method: Alternate the Gun Automaton and garden-building Tesla Coil. Lure enemies around the garden and prevent RPG soldiers from killing their allies.

collectibles.name: Wave 9
collectibles.location: Use only Vigors and finish within 60 seconds.
collectibles.method: Pull enemies off arriving airships with Undertow and push them over the map edge quickly.

collectibles.name: Wave 10
collectibles.location: Avoid all damage for 30 seconds.
collectibles.method: Crouch behind cover at the spawn immediately and stay hidden until the timer completes.

collectibles.name: Wave 11
collectibles.location: Kill every enemy with the Shotgun.
collectibles.method: Use the Shotgun Tear beneath the overhang by the medical supplies. Prioritize accurate headshots and prevent explosive friendly fire.

collectibles.name: Wave 12
collectibles.location: Pick up no weapons and loot no bodies.
collectibles.method: Enter with stocked guns and leave all corpses untouched. Ammunition thrown by Elizabeth is allowed.

collectibles.name: Wave 13
collectibles.location: Kill enemies while a Booker Decoy distracts them.
collectibles.method: Weaken the Patriots first, activate a Decoy Tear, and finish each target while it attacks the decoy. Open another Tear between Decoy uses to reset it.

collectibles.name: Wave 14
collectibles.location: Kill enemies with the same weapon types they carry.
collectibles.method: Bring a Machine Gun and Shotgun for their matching soldiers, then obtain the RPG from the garden-building Tear for RPG soldiers.

collectibles.name: Wave 15
collectibles.location: Use a different weapon for each killing blow.
collectibles.method: Kill the Handyman with one gun and a Fireman with the other. Finish the final Fireman with an unused damaging Vigor such as Undertow.

collectibles.name: Wave 1
collectibles.location: Have a Possessed Patriot kill a Bucking Bronco victim.
collectibles.method: Remove one Patriot, weaken a soldier beside the other, levitate the soldier, and possess the nearby Patriot so it delivers the finishing attack.

collectibles.name: Wave 2
collectibles.location: Kill two Sky-Line riders with traps.
collectibles.method: Place Devil’s Kiss traps under the far bridge and on the ceiling beside the highest building’s rails. Keep replacing them while enemies ride through.

collectibles.name: Wave 3
collectibles.location: Finish enemies using Tear hazards or Tear allies.
collectibles.method: Alternate Tesla Coils and summoned allies, letting their attacks finish every target.

collectibles.name: Wave 4
collectibles.location: Use a different weapon or Vigor for every kill.
collectibles.method: Bring weapons that enemies do not drop, then use dropped guns and unused Vigors to give each target a unique finishing blow.

collectibles.name: Wave 5
collectibles.location: Kill both Handymen while they electrify Sky-Lines.
collectibles.method: Weaken both, bait their grabs near the high balcony, and shoot their hearts only while each is holding the electrified rail.

collectibles.name: Wave 6
collectibles.location: Defeat every enemy with the Shotgun.
collectibles.method: Use Freight Hooks to reach the far side and work toward the snipers while keeping nearby soldiers under control.

collectibles.name: Wave 7
collectibles.location: Make Fireman self-destruction kill two enemies.
collectibles.method: Wait beside the far stairs for the group to gather. Use Shock Jockey to hold soldiers near weakened Firemen, then stop stunning when the Firemen begin to explode.

collectibles.name: Wave 8
collectibles.location: Finish within 80 seconds.
collectibles.method: Use Undertow to discard soldiers quickly. Stun the Patriot with Shock Jockey and shoot its rear gears.

collectibles.name: Wave 9
collectibles.location: Kill the Siren before destroying the Zeppelin.
collectibles.method: Reach the Zeppelin, focus gunfire and Devil’s Kiss on the Siren, then destroy the engine.

collectibles.name: Wave 10
collectibles.location: Use only the Sniper Rifle.
collectibles.method: Keep moving and make each shot count. Do not use damaging Vigors for crowd control.

collectibles.name: Wave 11
collectibles.location: Kill both Handymen while a Booker Decoy distracts them.
collectibles.method: Weaken them first, cycle between the two bridge Decoys, and fire high-damage shots while a Handyman is focused on the active decoy.

collectibles.name: Wave 12
collectibles.location: Finish every soldier and Zealot with Bucking Bronco followed by Charge.
collectibles.method: Perform the combo on the Zealots and soldiers. Kill the Patriots separately with other attacks.

collectibles.name: Wave 13
collectibles.location: Match every enemy’s weapon type for the kill.
collectibles.method: Bring a Pistol and another matching gun. The first airship provides a Machine Gun, Shotgun, and Hand Cannon for the other soldiers.

collectibles.name: Wave 14
collectibles.location: Have a Motorized Patriot Tear kill the Handyman.
collectibles.method: Weaken the Handyman, summon the Patriot, and leave the finishing damage to the ally.

collectibles.name: Wave 15
collectibles.location: Throw four bodies off Columbia before the Siren revives them.
collectibles.method: As airships drop corpses, immediately push the bodies over the edge with Undertow before the Siren reaches them.

achievements.description: Ride the Bathysphere in Burial at Sea – Episode 1.
achievements.summary: Ride the Bathysphere in Burial at Sea – Episode 1.

steps.text: Complete the meeting with Sander Cohen and take the ensuing Bathysphere journey.

achievements.description: Finish Burial at Sea – Episode 1.
achievements.summary: Finish Burial at Sea – Episode 1.

guide.context: Before raising the thermostat, finish nearby diary collection and combat tasks. For missing turret kills afterward, replay the Pavilion chapter.

steps.text: After completing your Housewares tasks, raise the thermostat and finish the final encounter.

achievements.description: Collected all Audio Diaries in Burial at Sea - Episode 1.
achievements.summary: In Burial at Sea – Episode 1, acquire all 17 Audio Diaries.

guide.context: Bring lockpicks for optional rooms. Finish the Market Street diaries before leaving with Cohen, and finish Housewares collection before raising the thermostat. If you miss a diary after leaving an area, use Play Add-On Content to replay that chapter and collect the missing recording; earlier diary credit remains.

collectibles.name: Doing Well By Doing Good
collectibles.location: Apartment building 907, near the window with the working Big Daddy.
collectibles.method: Go behind the reception counter and search its lower shelf.

collectibles.name: Observation #33
collectibles.location: Maison Vosges, upstairs dressing rooms.
collectibles.method: Enter the second dressing room and search the table.

collectibles.name: Offer of Employment
collectibles.location: Maintenance room through the passage right of Golden Rule.
collectibles.method: Enter 2076 on the keypad and take the recording from the rear table.

collectibles.name: Audio Diary 4
collectibles.location: Watched Clock restaurant kitchen.
collectibles.method: Search the counter beyond the ovens before visiting Cohen.

collectibles.name: Left Behind
collectibles.location: Vent opposite the Menswear dressing-room turret.
collectibles.method: Crawl into the red vent and search the Hop Up Cola crate.

collectibles.name: The Old Bear
collectibles.location: Daily Bread, behind the locked door in Menswear.
collectibles.method: Spend one lockpick and search beneath the bar counter on the right.

collectibles.name: Critics
collectibles.location: Haberdashery, dressing-room corridor.
collectibles.method: After passing the turret, search the third dressing room counting from the right.

collectibles.name: Insufficient Postage
collectibles.location: Shoe Department, room beyond the keypad door.
collectibles.method: Enter 0928 and search the desk in the room beyond the turret.

collectibles.name: Message In A Bottle
collectibles.location: Jewelry Department, locked back-left room.
collectibles.method: Spend three lockpicks and take the recording from the desk ahead.

collectibles.name: False Advertising
collectibles.location: Fontaine Plasmids, lower-floor safe.
collectibles.method: Spend three lockpicks on the safe to obtain its diary.

collectibles.name: A Gift From Fontaine
collectibles.location: Jack Frost’s Village souvenir shop.
collectibles.method: Use Shock Jockey on the shop switch and search the overturned desk.

collectibles.name: Ghost In The Machine
collectibles.location: Pret-A-Porter, rear dressing rooms.
collectibles.method: Use Old Man Winter to cross the water. Search the dressing room containing the Shotgun.

collectibles.name: Oven of the Future
collectibles.location: Electronics, broken elevator at the bottom of the stairs.
collectibles.method: Take the recording inside the elevator.

collectibles.name: The Kiss
collectibles.location: Bistro lower-floor counter.
collectibles.method: Search beside the register; use nearby code 3958 to obtain the Radar Range too.

collectibles.name: Observation #17
collectibles.location: Customer Service kiosk beyond the Appliances airlock.
collectibles.method: Search the back-room desk next to the Little Sister vent.

collectibles.name: A Little Help
collectibles.location: Bridal shop right of Customer Service.
collectibles.method: Spend one lockpick, then search the shelf below the sales counter.

collectibles.name: Observation #22
collectibles.location: Room right of the ice bridge beyond the Showroom.
collectibles.method: Have Elizabeth open the rear door, climb back up from the rocket turret, create the ice bridge with Old Man Winter, and search the room’s desk.

achievements.description: Purchased any two upgrades for Old Man Winter or Radar Range in Burial at Sea - Episode 1.
achievements.summary: Buy any two Old Man Winter or Radar Range upgrades in Burial at Sea – Episode 1.

guide.context: Buying both Radar Range upgrades at an Ammo Bandito is another option costing 350 dollars.

steps.text: Save 350 dollars and buy both Old Man Winter upgrades from a Gene Bank. A Gene Bank is on the Pavilion’s third floor.

achievements.description: Destroyed ten Turrets in Burial at Sea - Episode 1.
achievements.summary: In Burial at Sea – Episode 1, destroy 10 turrets yourself.

guide.context: Turrets destroyed by Splicers or an exploding Radar Range victim do not count. The counter keeps kills across replays.

steps.text: Shoot turrets yourself in the Pavilion and Housewares. After finishing the episode, replay chapter 4 and destroy its turrets again if more kills are needed.

achievements.description: Made 5 enemies explode with the Radar Range in Burial at Sea - Episode 1.
achievements.summary: In Burial at Sea – Episode 1, explode five enemies by heating them with the Radar Range.

steps.text: In Housewares, enter the Bistro’s lower floor and use code 3958 to obtain the Radar Range.
Keep the beam on a Splicer until the body explodes. Do this to five enemies; Housewares supplies respawning Splicers.

achievements.description: Damaged fifteen foes with an exploding enemy, using the Radar Range in Burial at Sea - Episode 1.
achievements.summary: Damage 15 enemies with Radar Range victim explosions in Burial at Sea – Episode 1.

guide.context: Additional Splicers spawn as you move between Housewares rooms.

steps.text: Obtain the Radar Range from the Bistro using code 3958. Heat a Splicer until the body explodes while other enemies are nearby. Keep damaging nearby foes this way until the counter reaches 15.

achievements.description: Shattered 5 enemies who had been frozen with Old Man Winter.
achievements.summary: Shatter five enemies frozen by Old Man Winter in Burial at Sea – Episode 1.

steps.text: Obtain Old Man Winter in Jack Frost’s Village. Freeze a Splicer, then strike the frozen body with the Air-Grabber; shatter five enemies this way.

achievements.description: Froze 2 enemies with the same Old Man Winter trap.
achievements.summary: Freeze at least two enemies with one Old Man Winter trap in Burial at Sea – Episode 1.

steps.text: After taking Old Man Winter in Jack Frost’s Village, charge the Plasmid to place a trap in front of the incoming Splicer group. Let two enemies enter the same trap.

achievements.description: Ride the tram in Burial at Sea – Episode 1.
achievements.summary: In Burial at Sea – Episode 1, take the tram journey.

steps.text: Use Old Man Winter to bridge the water to Pavilion Station, then take the transport to Housewares.

achievements.description: Repair the Lutece device in Burial at Sea – Episode 2.
achievements.summary: Repair the Lutece device in Burial at Sea – Episode 2.

steps.text: Bring the three required components back to the Silverfin, repair the device, and enter its Tear.

achievements.description: Deliver the hair sample in Burial at Sea – Episode 2.
achievements.summary: In Burial at Sea – Episode 2, deliver the hair sample through Suchong’s Tear.

steps.text: Take the hair sample back to the First Lady and pass through Suchong’s Tear.

achievements.description: Finish Burial at Sea – Episode 2.
achievements.summary: Finish Burial at Sea – Episode 2.

steps.text: Finish Suchong’s clinic, then give Atlas the Ace in the Hole.

achievements.description: Collected all Audio Diaries and Voxophones in Burial at Sea - Episode 2.
achievements.summary: In Burial at Sea – Episode 2, acquire all 25 Audio Diaries and Voxophones.

guide.context: Collect the four coded notes before attempting the wine-bottle room. In Columbia, take Sacrifices from the blue airship before it departs. A missed recording can be recovered through chapter select. Keep this checklist because the in-game audio history rolls back with the selected chapter.

collectibles.name: Laissez-Faire
collectibles.location: Cupid’s Arrow, back-left shop counter.
collectibles.method: Take the recording beside the Employees Only door.

collectibles.name: The Blue Dress
collectibles.location: Cupid’s Arrow, locked Employees Only room.
collectibles.method: Pick the door and search beside the mannequin wearing the blue dress. Take Peeping Tom here too.

collectibles.name: Pennies on the Dollar
collectibles.location: Silverfin kitchen, near a locked door.
collectibles.method: Reach the Silverfin through the Maintenance vent, then search the kitchen desk.

collectibles.name: Imprinting Roadblocks
collectibles.location: Silverfin upstairs.
collectibles.method: Search the table beneath the drawing board in the left corner.

collectibles.name: The Atlas Guy
collectibles.location: Test-Drive, staff office behind the kiosk.
collectibles.method: Use the Employees Only door and search the rear desk.

collectibles.name: Old Man Winter Giveaway
collectibles.location: Atlas’s lower hideout beneath Test-Drive.
collectibles.method: Visit the Silverfin first to gain entry, descend twice, and search the corner desk under the floor you came from.

collectibles.name: For All Occasions
collectibles.location: Atlas’s hideout, central war table.
collectibles.method: Take the recording in front of the large map.

collectibles.name: Prison Intel
collectibles.location: Employees room beside Old Man Winter.
collectibles.method: Before collecting the Plasmid, take the recording held by the body in the side room.

collectibles.name: Hooligans
collectibles.location: Service Bay, lower-floor locker room.
collectibles.method: Go below the Stingray display and search the sink at the rear.

collectibles.name: Building the Impossible!
collectibles.location: Locked room along the Service Bay’s lower floor.
collectibles.method: Spend three lockpicks and search the shelving straight ahead.

collectibles.name: So Long, Suckers!
collectibles.location: Blue Bathysphere on the platform opposite the Stingray entrance.
collectibles.method: Use the Freight Hook to reach the platform, then search the seat inside.

collectibles.name: C'est La Vie
collectibles.location: Manta Ray Lounge, main upstairs bar.
collectibles.method: Search beside the body left of the bar.

collectibles.name: Atlas Provides
collectibles.location: Locked room across the flooded section below the Lounge’s main area.
collectibles.method: Spend two lockpicks and take the recording from the dish rack.

collectibles.name: You Stupid Bastard
collectibles.location: Fontaine’s costume room behind the wine-bottle puzzle.
collectibles.method: Collect the four coded notes: Information’s rear table in Bathysphere Deluxe; the left room beneath Medicine From Your Pal Atlas; a lit desk beyond the Old Man Winter staff room; and the Service Bay side-room desk beyond Building the Impossible. At the Lounge’s upper dead end, turn the three wine labels toward you and search the opened room’s desk.

collectibles.name: The Quality of Mercy
collectibles.location: Room left of the glass door beside the vent exit beyond Fink’s Office.
collectibles.method: Search the worktable after leaving the vent.

collectibles.name: Sacrifices
collectibles.location: Blue airship above the starting Sky-Lines.
collectibles.method: Ride up, land on the wing, and take the recording from the crate near the paintings. Do this before continuing; the airship later leaves.

collectibles.name: Stay the Hand
collectibles.location: Office of Jeremiah Fink.
collectibles.method: Search the desk directly beyond the large double doors.

collectibles.name: The Lazarus Project
collectibles.location: Private Quarters, Sleep Room.
collectibles.method: Take the recording from the floor in front of the fireplace.

collectibles.name: No Profit for the Prophets
collectibles.location: Private Quarters, Leisure Room.
collectibles.method: Collect the Clock Key, unlock the room, and search its small central table.

collectibles.name: Necessary Precautions
collectibles.location: Laboratory room right of the gold Fink statue.
collectibles.method: Follow the walkway right and search in front of the chalkboard.

collectibles.name: The Greater Good
collectibles.location: Ground-floor room facing the gold statue’s right side.
collectibles.method: Search the central counter near the ADAM Slugs.

collectibles.name: Childish Fears
collectibles.location: Surgical Suite, Parts Inventory beyond the Patient Ward.
collectibles.method: Before entering the vent, turn right into Parts Inventory and search the desk.

collectibles.name: Table Scraps
collectibles.location: Observation room reached after obtaining the hair sample.
collectibles.method: Open the security gates, return to the room with the Automaton and airship access, and enter the newly opened gate left of the Automaton’s position. Search the desk by the glass.

collectibles.name: Product Recall
collectibles.location: Open locker right of the entrance with the suspended Big Daddy suits.
collectibles.method: Pick up the recording when you enter the clinic after Atlas.

collectibles.name: Mind Control Test
collectibles.location: Cognitive Conversion room.
collectibles.method: After helping the Big Daddy, follow the right-hand hall and take the diary from the room’s desk.

achievements.description: Finish Burial at Sea – Episode 2 in 1998 Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete Burial at Sea – Episode 2 using 1998 Mode.

guide.context: This mode removes lethal weapon options, so its restrictions fit the episode’s knockout achievements.

steps.text: Start the episode in 1998 Mode. Use stealth, Peeping Tom, the Air-Grabber, and the available nonlethal bolts to get past enemies.
Finish the episode without changing away from 1998 Mode.

achievements.description: Gained five noisemakers through lockpicking.
achievements.summary: Obtain five Noisemakers from lockpicking in Burial at Sea – Episode 2.

steps.text: During lockpicking, stop the moving needle over a blue cylinder to earn a Noisemaker. Do this five times; locked turrets also provide opportunities.

achievements.description: Knocked out two or more enemies using the same Gas Bolt.
achievements.summary: Knock out at least two enemies with a single Gas Bolt in Burial at Sea – Episode 2.

steps.text: Collect Gas Bolts after taking the Service Bay elevator back up. Shoot one into the group of Splicers near the front desk so the gas knocks out at least two.

achievements.description: Used Ironsides to collect 20 rounds of ammo or more in Burial at Sea - Episode 2.
achievements.summary: Collect at least 20 rounds of ammunition with Ironsides in Burial at Sea – Episode 2.

guide.context: Your inventory needs empty ammunition space; absorbing health instead does not advance the counter.

steps.text: Collect Ironsides on the First Lady in Columbia. On returning to Rapture, empty your ammunition before the fight in Suchong’s lab.
Hold Ironsides toward shooting enemies to absorb their rounds. Refill EVE around the room and reload the checkpoint for further ammunition credit if needed.

achievements.description: On three occasions, knocked out an enemy after silently dropping off a Freight Hook.
achievements.summary: Knock out enemies three times just after silently dropping from Freight Hooks in Burial at Sea – Episode 2.

steps.text: Drop from a Freight Hook behind a Splicer while holding crouch. Use the Air-Grabber to knock the Splicer out within about four seconds of landing; do this three times.

achievements.description: While invisible, used Peeping Tom to knock out 15 enemies with a melee attack.
achievements.summary: Melee-knock out 15 enemies while invisible through Peeping Tom in Burial at Sea – Episode 2.

steps.text: Take Peeping Tom from Cupid’s Arrow. Activate invisibility before approaching a Splicer, then knock the Splicer out with the Air-Grabber. Do this 15 times.
